_instructions: Fill one entry per volunteer, then ask the agent to 'seed the demo volunteers' (or run: pnpm run seed:volunteers in artifacts/api-server).
Entries whose name/email still contain 'FILL-' are skipped, so you can leave unused rows as-is.
email + phone are where the AI agent will REALLY send messages and place calls once allow-listed.
phone must be in international format, e.g. +919876543210 or +14155551234. Leave "" for email-only volunteers.
IMPORTANT (Twilio trial): each phone must also be verified in the Twilio console (Phone Numbers -> Verified Caller IDs) before live calls/WhatsApp work.
channelPreference: email | whatsapp | both. geography drives timezone for call slots (India, United States, UK, Europe, Singapore).
joiningDate: YYYY-MM-DD, a near-future date makes the demo most realistic (day-before call, SLA timers).
After seeding, the loader prints the exact allowlist value; the agent will set ONBOARDING_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS so real sends/calls only reach your volunteers.
